pip.description: A small round penguin wizard chick with black-and-white felted feathers, a little orange beak and orange feet, wearing a blue felt wizard robe and a tall floppy pointed blue wizard hat, both dotted with small yellow felt stars, and carrying a short wooden wand.

teacher.description: An elderly owl wizard with speckled brown-and-cream felted feathers, feathery ear tufts and bushy feather eyebrows, wearing long flowing grey wizard robes with wide sleeves.

rival.description: A young red fox wizard with russet fur, a white muzzle and a bushy white-tipped tail, wearing a fancy red felt robe with gold trim and a matching red pointed hat, with a smug, confident face.

phoenix.description: A young phoenix chick with flame-colored felt plumage in reds, oranges and golds, a sweeping tail of ember-orange feathers, and little wisps of felted flame at its wingtips.

unicorn.description: A white unicorn with a soft cream felted mane and tail, a small golden spiral horn, and slender legs.

branch.description: A strong straight living branch of pale wood, about as tall as Pip, with a few small green felt leaves near its tip.

small_crystal.description: A small clear crystal that fits in Pip's flipper, smooth and simple, glowing with a soft steady white light.

classroom.description: A cozy wizard's study with a few spellbooks stacked on a wooden desk, a tall pointed window, and a small rug on the floor.

forest_path.description: A winding dirt path leading away from the wizard's tower, lined with a few tall pine trees and small tufts of grass.

forest_clearing.description: A small sunlit clearing with one big leafy tree in the middle holding a tidy twig nest.

river.description: A fast-flowing river with rocky banks and a tall leaning riverside tree, one strong branch stretching out over the rushing water.

grove_entrance.description: A softly glowing magical grove with a few slender silver-barked trees and patches of luminous moss.

grove_fork.description: A forest fork where a dark stone cave mouth sits on one side and a dense thorny thicket bristles on the other.

troll_cave.description: A shadowy stone cave with a lumpy rock floor and a scatter of gnawed bones in the corner.

thicket.description: A tangle of thorny vines and brambles clumped between a couple of bare trees.

waterfall.description: A tall roaring waterfall crashing into a wide pool, with a few wet mossy boulders along the edge.

bog.description: A mucky swamp of brown mud and stagnant puddles, dotted with a few drooping reeds.

tunnel_fork.description: A damp cavern mouth hidden behind the waterfall, splitting into two passages - one glittering, one dark.

crystal_pit.description: A deep, dark pit at the bottom of the crystal chamber, walls studded with broken crystal shards.

flooding_chamber.description: The crystal chamber again, now with meltwater rushing in across the floor and rising fast around the crystals.

opening.text:
Pip has practiced this spell every evening for a whole year - levitating pebbles, books, even a sleepy teacup when no one was looking.

Now, standing in the middle of the classroom with their teacher watching, Pip's flippers tremble just a little. Their heart thumps like a drum... but this time, they really are ready to try.

Pip squeezes their eyes shut and pictures a fearsome dragon. Scales. Wings. Fire.

A worm. Somehow, Pip pictures a worm.

POOF. In a puff of sparkles, Pip is a very small earthworm in a very large wizard hat. The teacher slowly raises one feathery eyebrow.

a_birds_eye_view.text:
With a wobbling flourish, Pip casts the spell.

The teacher rises off the rug - up, up - hooting with delighted laughter. "Oh my! Put me down, put me down. Well... maybe one more loop."

When his talons touch the floor again, his eyes are twinkling. "You're ready, Pip. Time for the next step in your studies."

on_the_road.title: On the Road
on_the_road.text:
"A wizard's staff is not bought, Pip. It is gathered," the teacher calls. "A branch for the body. A gift for the core. A crystal for the focus. Come home when all three have chosen you."

Pip grips their hat. A real staff. Real spells.

"And Pip - the forest rewards patience. Remember that, even when others forget it."

Pip spots it right away: a strong living branch, green leaves, perfectly straight. The perfect staff base.

There is just one problem. Tucked between the twigs sits a neat little nest, and inside the nest rest three speckled eggs, warm and fragile.

momma_bird_returns.text:
Pip's flipper barely brushes the bark when the sky explodes into feathers.

"CHEEP-CHEEP-CHEEEEP!" Momma bird is home, and she is NOT happy about visitors.

She squawks. She flaps. She pecks Pip's hat right down over their eyes. Pip runs out of the clearing blind, arms waving, all the way back to the path.

the_river_branch.title: The River Branch
the_river_branch.text:
Pip finds another good branch - but it hangs far out over rushing water. The current roars and splashes below.

Pip's stomach flips. Climbing out there would be quick... and slippery, and soaked, and probably very splashy.

Or Pip could slow down, breathe, and do this like a wizard.

a_little_wet.text:
Pip scoots along the branch. So far so good.

Pip looks down. Not so good.

The river gives one big splash, the branch gives one little wiggle, and Pip's flippers give up entirely. SPLOOSH.

Pip drags themself back to shore looking like a very disappointed mop.

the_grove.title: The Grove
the_grove.text:
Pip reaches a glowing grove - and stops short.

Red Fox is there, gripping a frightened young phoenix and yanking out tail feathers one by one. "Hold STILL," he snaps. "My staff is going to be LEGENDARY, and legendary staffs need phoenix feathers."

The phoenix cries out. A loose feather drifts past Pip, glowing like an ember. It WOULD make an amazing core...

fox_toasted.text:
"STOP!" Pip's shout rings through the grove.

Red Fox jumps, loses his grip, and the phoenix bursts free in a spray of sparks. It circles once over Pip's head - then turns on Red Fox with a WHOOMPH.

When the smoke clears, Red Fox stands blinking, toasted from ears to tail. The phoenix settles onto a branch and gives Pip a small, warm nod.

scorched.text:
One feather. Surely the phoenix won't miss one little feather.

Pip reaches out - and the phoenix flares like a firework. WHOOMPH. It rockets skyward in a spray of sparks, gone.

Pip sits down hard, smoking gently. Beside them, Red Fox is smoking too. "This," he coughs, "is YOUR fault, waddle-wizard."

Pip goes very still. Fireballs... at an ice wall... holding back a mountain's worth of melted snow?

That does not sound clever. That sounds dangerous.

Pip's flippers hover between them.

home_again.title: Home Again
home_again.text:
Pip walks the last stretch of road home as the sun comes up, the finished staff humming softly in their flippers.

The teacher takes one look and his eyes go bright. "A gathered staff. A chosen staff." He taps the floor with one wing. "Now then - you owe me a levitation. This time, with your own staff."

Pip grins and raises it high.
